module: Flowgraph node 'Merge' (simple category). Groups up to 4 numbers x, y, z, w into a table {x, y, z, w} (type vec3, color or quat) on the 'value' output.
notes: Nil inputs leave holes in the table; a missing w gives a 3-element table (vec3).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Builds {x, y, z, w} from the inputs and writes it to the output.
